page_title: EMP 0-0 JUV | Empoli v Juventus 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' The corner from Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is hurriedly cleared.

90+5' What a great touch by Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out of play and Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' A substitution has been made. Liam Henderson is replaced by Nicolas Haas (Empoli).
87' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

87' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
85' Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) sprays a pass out to Pietro Pellegri, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
82' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
82' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
80' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) receives the ball from Nicolo Fagioli and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.
79' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sebastiano Esposito leaves the pitch and Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) comes on.
77' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) replacing Alberto Grassi.
75' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
75' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.

74' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. A rebound falls kindly for Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!

73' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mattia Perin pulls off an easy save.
72' It's like he was asking for a caution. Khephren Thuram (Juventus) receives a yellow card.
69' Timothy Weah (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who smothers the ball.
67' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) replaces Douglas Luiz.
67' Here comes a substitution. Timothy Weah (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Gonzalez.
67' Substitution. Kenan Yildiz did his best and is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
67' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Manuel Locatelli will be replaced by Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) replaces Lorenzo Colombo.
62' Bremer (Juventus) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
58' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus).
56' Bremer (Juventus) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

53' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
52' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the corner but it's cleared.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach pulls off a brilliant save.
49' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

48' A long pass finds Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies low towards the middle of the goal, but Mattia Perin reacts well to make a good save.
47' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
47' Douglas Luiz sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
47' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
46' Referee Marco Di Bello blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Liam Henderson (Empoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
39' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) blazes a shot from a long-range free kick and the ball ends somewhere in row Z.
39' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) brings his opponent down. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus have a free kick.
37' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) will deliver the corner kick.

36' Federico Gatti (Juventus) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
36' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
33' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the left post.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:4. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
28' My Gran could have done better! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
27' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach punches the ball away.
25' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
25' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
23' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends a long ball in, but Mattia Perin comfortably gathers the ball.
22' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) sprays a pass out to Kenan Yildiz, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
19' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
18' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) sends a long ball in, but Mattia Perin comfortably gathers the ball.
16' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach has no trouble gathering it.
15' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
14' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to play a long through ball into Dusan Vlahovic, but the defence breaks the move down.
12' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Liam Henderson (Empoli) sends it out of play.
12' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.
10' The foul by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

8' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
5' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
5' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
3' Some neat passing and movement from Juventus as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

The players are on the pitch and Empoli will have the kick-off.
